def make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return n distinct non-negative record ids, the same list on every run for the same seed."""
    pre n >= 0
    post out.len() == n
    post {x for x in out}.len() == n
    post all([x >= 0 for x in out])
    ex make_ids(0, 7) == []
    ex make_ids(3, 1).len() == 3
    ex make_ids(3, 1) == make_ids(3, 1)
    m = 1000000007
    base = seed % m
    if base < 0:
        base += m
    out: list[int] = []
    for i in range(n):
        out.append(base + i)
    return out
